title: The chat mirror is one device key shared by every tab, and tabs can show different records
evidence: Found 2026-11-26 in PR 2119's review: widget-src/src/lib/storage.ts saveToLocalStorage and widget-src/src/lib/chat-mirror.ts writeMirror write one localStorage key, last writer wins across tabs. A guest tab and a connected tab show different records, so one can leave the other's lists in the mirror; under a held change a page's own-save read keeps them beside its own saved profile until its next whole read (useRecordApply signal, US-34 AC10 Limit). Older than AC10. Root fix candidates: key the mirror by record identity, or keep a per-tab snapshot of the saved lists.
